title: Horns of Hattin vs Cappadocian Riders
lede:
Cappadocian Riders won 33-11 on Victory Points in Battle Round 4, holding the centre and the left objective in all four rounds and the right in two.

The Horns of Hattin had three bodies on the board against five: its Primary paid it 9 VP, but it won one objective once and lost the centre twice on OC 11 vs 12.
result_line: Cappadocian Riders win 33-11 on Victory Points in Battle Round 4
deployment: Central Faceoff on CROSSROADS, three objectives on row 7: the 3 VP centre at (7,7) and 2 VP flanks at (1,7) and (13,7); an Objective Area is the objective square and the eight around it. Horns of Hattin put almost all its 248 RP into two leader-and-bodyguard pairs on the home line beside its HQ at (7,13): Saladin - Al-Malik al-Nasir (Mounted) with Khassakiyya Guard 1 at (4,13) and the Isfahsalar with Khassakiyya Guard 2 at (11,13), with the 13 RP Muqatila Troopers at (7,12) between them. Cappadocian Riders spread six units along rows 1 and 2 in front of its HQ at (7,1): the Archistrategos (Mounted) with Crimson Knights 1 at (9,2), Crimson Knights 2 at (5,2), Akritic Outriders at (11,1), Dragoon Brethren at (3,1) and Covenant Levies at (3,2). The Horns had Priority with fewer units on the battlefield (6 to 7). The set-up gave the Riders a unit for each objective and the Horns two hard-hitting pairs and one cheap squad to take three.

1.title: The Riders take the centre and the left unopposed

feed.text: Primaries revealed: LEAD FROM THE FRONT for the Horns, BREAK THEIR HOLD for the Riders. Secondaries kept: FORWARD DEPLOYMENT and BREAK CONTACT. The Horns spent 2 of their 3 CP on Double Time for the Muqatila Troopers, which bought nothing, and Matter Transmutation put Zi'baq Beads (SUSTAINED ATTACK 1) on Khassakiyya Guard 1's Qilij Sabre for 1 Al-Kimiya Ingredient.

Crimson Knights 1 with the Archistrategos rode 9,2 to 7,7, onto the centre, and the Covenant Levies walked to 2,7, on the left objective. Crimson Knights 2 went to 3,6, the Dragoon Brethren to 8,4 and the Akritic Outriders to 11,7, one square outside the right objective's area. The Horns came up to meet them: the Muqatila Troopers to 3,9, Saladin and Khassakiyya Guard 1 to 8,9, the Isfahsalar and Khassakiyya Guard 2 to 9,9.
Nobody fired: every unit on the board had no legal action. Praying gave the Riders 6 Mana.
The Riders scored the centre on OC 9 vs 0 (3 VP) and the left on 10 vs 0 (2 VP). The right scored nobody. 0-5.

2.title: Three charges, and the Riders slip out of all of them

feed.text: The Riders spent 3 of their 4 CP on Troop Requisition: a second Covenant Levies at 7,2. The Horns held all 4 of their CP. Secondaries kept: MAN OF THE HOUR and COORDINATED PUSH. Naft Pitch (ABLAZE) went on the Muqatila Troopers' Khanjar for 2 Al-Kimiya Ingredients.

The Horns charged three ways: the Muqatila Troopers into the Covenant Levies on the left objective (3,9 to 1,7), Saladin and Khassakiyya Guard 1 into the Dragoon Brethren and the new Covenant Levies (8,9 to 8,5), the Isfahsalar and Khassakiyya Guard 2 into the Archistrategos and Crimson Knights 1 (9,9 to 8,8). Crimson Knights 2 charged the Muqatila Troopers from 3,6 to 1,8, and the Akritic Outriders stepped into the right objective's area at 12,8. Then the Dragoon Brethren failed their Fall Back test (4, needing 6), took 3 in disorder and landed at 6,6, and Crimson Knights 1 with the Archistrategos broke away on a 5 to 6,7; both stayed inside the centre's Objective Area. COORDINATED PUSH completed at the end of the phase (+2 VP, +1 CP).

Khassakiyya Guard 1's Rumh Lances put 12 into the new Covenant Levies (20 to 8) and Saladin's Zulfiqar of Ali the last 8; the RETRIBUTION Miracle let the Levies strike before they were removed, 1 hit on Saladin for nothing. Covenant Levies destroyed, the 3 CP requisition, 10 RP. With the EXALTATION Miracle, Crimson Knights 2's Dragonbane Lances landed 9 hits for 18 on the Muqatila Troopers (20 to 2, nine dead); the Muqatila's one Khanjar hit and the Covenant Levies' bayonets both did nothing. The Riders used FORTITUDE twice, TAXIARCH OF MIRACLES keeping the first use from being spent. Khassakiyya Guard 2 and the Isfahsalar, their targets gone, did nothing.

The Riders scored all three: the centre on OC 12 vs 11, the left on 16 vs 1 and the right on 3 vs 0 through the Akritic Outriders, 7 VP. BREAK CONTACT completed for the two units that broke away (+2). LEAD FROM THE FRONT paid the Horns 3, their characters in Objective Areas or the enemy half. 3-16.

3.title: Seven CP of Muqatila Troopers die to one volley

feed.text: The BENEDICTION Miracle healed the Dragoon Brethren for 3. The Horns spent all 7 CP: Troop Requisition (5) placed new Muqatila Troopers at 5,12 and Double Time (2) put them in reach of 4,7. The Riders spent 3 CP on Double Time for the Covenant Levies, which were engaged on the left objective and did not move. Naft Pitch went on Khassakiyya Guard 1's Qilij Sabre. Secondaries kept: FOCUSED FIRE and COMMAND AUTHORITY; FORWARD DEPLOYMENT expired for the Horns.

The new Muqatila Troopers ran 5,12 to 4,7. Crimson Knights 1 with the Archistrategos charged Saladin and Khassakiyya Guard 1 from 6,7 to 7,6; Khassakiyya Guard 1 failed its Fall Back test (2, needing 6), lost 3 in disorder and broke away with Saladin to 12,6, through the Akritic Outriders' Overwatch (with PROVIDENCE, 3 hits, all saved). TRAPEZITE HARASSMENT then took the Outriders 12,8 to 11,10, out of the right objective's area. Khassakiyya Guard 2 and the Isfahsalar moved to 7,8, still in the centre's.

Khassakiyya Guard 2's carbines took 1 off the Dragoon Brethren (12 to 11). The Dragoon Brethren answered with Successive Discharge (+1 FR) and SWEEP: 14 Grenade Gun hits, 20 damage, and the new Muqatila Troopers destroyed before they had acted, 13 RP. Passage by Fire then went to Crimson Knights 1 and the Archistrategos: the AI picked them for the 2-square move and moved nothing, so they stayed at 7,6 inside the centre's area. The 2 HP Muqatila Troopers attacked the Covenant Levies, who struck first (INI 5 to 4) and killed them: Muqatila Troopers destroyed, 13 RP. The Akritic Outriders and Saladin traded shots for nothing.

The Riders held the centre on OC 12 vs 11 again and the left on 16 vs 0 (5 VP). The Horns took the right on 7 vs 0 with Saladin and Khassakiyya Guard 1 (2 VP), and BREAK THEIR HOLD paid nothing: no Riders unit stood in that area. LEAD FROM THE FRONT paid 3. 8-21.

4.title: Saladin leaves the right and the Riders reach 33

feed.text: Both sides spent 3 CP on Secure Objective: the Horns on Khassakiyya Guard 2, the Riders on the Dragoon Brethren; the record prices both at nothing. Zarnikh Paste (POISON) went on Khassakiyya Guard 1's Qilij Sabre. Secondaries kept: TAKE UP THE GAUNTLET, for which the Riders named the left objective, and SECURE THE FLANKS; FOCUSED FIRE and COMMAND AUTHORITY expired.

Saladin and Khassakiyya Guard 1 left the right objective, 12,6 to 9,7, outside every Objective Area; the Akritic Outriders went straight back to 12,8. Crimson Knights 2 failed a charge and did not move. The Covenant Levies walked off the left objective to 5,7. Crimson Knights 1 with the Archistrategos charged the Isfahsalar and Khassakiyya Guard 2 at 8,8 from 7,6, and the Dragoon Brethren moved to 6,8, both into the centre's area.

The Isfahsalar attacked, but the charging Knights struck first: 4 Dragonbane Lance hits, 8 on Khassakiyya Guard 2 (15 to 7); the Isfahsalar's Dabbus Mace gave 4 back (15 to 11). The Archistrategos used Quis ut Deus? and his Archangel's Sword took Khassakiyya Guard 2 to 5 HP and one model. Khassakiyya Guard 1's carbines did 4 to the Akritic Outriders and Saladin's Shihab Pistol 2 more (9 to 3, one Outrider left). The Dragoon Brethren's 5 hits on Saladin were all saved; the Outriders' Spot & Mark raised Saladin and Khassakiyya Guard 1 to MARKED, and the Covenant Levies' 9 hits on Khassakiyya Guard 1 were all saved too.

The Riders held all three: the centre on OC 15 vs 11, the left on 6 vs 0 with Crimson Knights 2 alone, and the right on 1 vs 0 with the last Akritic Outrider, 7 VP. BREAK THEIR HOLD paid 3 for taking back the objective the Horns held at the round's start, and SECURE THE FLANKS completed (+2 VP, +1 CP). LEAD FROM THE FRONT paid the Horns 3. 11-33, the Riders past 30.

analysis.title: Why it went this way
analysis.html:
Where the VP came from

Cappadocian Riders took 24 of their 33 VP from objectives (5, 7, 5 and 7 a round), 6 from three secondaries (BREAK CONTACT and COORDINATED PUSH in Round 2, SECURE THE FLANKS in Round 4) and 3 from BREAK THEIR HOLD, all of it in Round 4. Horns of Hattin scored 9 of their 11 from LEAD FROM THE FRONT, the card's 3 in every round from Round 2, and 2 from the right objective in Round 3. They completed no secondary: MAN OF THE HOUR needed one unit to destroy two units (Saladin destroyed one), FOCUSED FIRE three units on one target in an Action Phase, which three bodies on three fronts never managed, and TAKE UP THE GAUNTLET the left objective, where the Horns had nobody left after Round 3.

{{chart:objectives}}

What the key units did

The Riders' objective units did the scoring. Crimson Knights 1 with the Archistrategos held the centre in every round (6.1 and 4.2 VP, 9 and 6 VP hinged), the Dragoon Brethren beside them (4.6 VP, 9 hinged) after their Round 2 Fall Back landed them still inside the area. On the left the Covenant Levies (4.0 VP, 40 per 100 RP) and Crimson Knights 2 (5.4) never let go, and the 22 RP Akritic Outriders took the right twice (5.4 VP, 24.5 per 100 RP), the second time with one model left. The Dragoon Brethren did the most damage on the board, 20, all of it into the requisitioned Muqatila Troopers; Crimson Knights 2 did 18 to the first ones.

For the Horns, Khassakiyya Guard 1 (16 damage) and Saladin (10) killed the only Riders unit to die, the requisitioned Covenant Levies, while the centre they needed stayed with the Riders. The Isfahsalar, 60 RP, was idle in three rounds and struck once. The Horns lost both Muqatila Troopers, 26 RP, and destroyed 10.

{{chart:rp-trade}}

What the Horns could not do

It could not hold ground. Its scoring units were two pairs and one squad: the first Muqatila Troopers charged onto the left objective and were cut to one model by Crimson Knights 2 the same round, and the second died to a single volley the round they were bought. The centre went to the Riders on OC 12 vs 11 in both Rounds 2 and 3, a single point, with Khassakiyya Guard 2 and the Isfahsalar in it alone. Their Primary paid what it could: LEAD FROM THE FRONT stops at 3 VP a round however many characters go forward.

{{chart:attrition}}

The AI, not the army

  • Round 4, Saladin and Khassakiyya Guard 1 walked off the right objective to 9,7, outside every Objective Area. The last Akritic Outrider took it back on OC 1 vs 0 and BREAK THEIR HOLD paid 3 for it: 5 of the Riders' 12 VP that round. Without them the Riders end the round on 28 and the battle goes on.
  • Command Points: the Horns held 4 CP through Round 2 while the centre went 12 vs 11, then spent 7 in Round 3 on a Troop Requisition and Double Time for Muqatila Troopers that ran into the Dragoon Brethren's guns and died without acting. The Riders' Round 3 Double Time (3 CP) went to Covenant Levies that were engaged and could not move; both Round 4 Secure Objectives bought nothing.
  • Matter Transmutation coated Khassakiyya Guard 1's Qilij Sabre three times (Zi'baq Beads, Naft Pitch, Zarnikh Paste), and the sabre never struck: the unit fought with its Rumh Lances and carbines. All four coatings bought nothing.
  • Passage by Fire: this is the same-seed replay of a battle that stood still in Round 3 after the Dragoon Brethren's kill, when the rule handed a MOUNTED unit a 2-square move the browser never started; this time it went to Crimson Knights 1 and the Archistrategos, the AI declined the move, and they kept their place in the centre, which they hinged that round.
  • The Fall Back record is inflated: four of its eleven entries are charge-planning probes, the engagers never adjacent when asked: Round 2 Crimson Knights 2 "held" (the Muqatila Troopers were at 3,9, the Knights at 3,6), Round 3 Khassakiyya Guard 2 "held" (Crimson Knights 1 never came within one square), Round 4 the Akritic Outriders' "risky hold" (at 11,10, Saladin's pair at 12,6) and Round 4 the Horns' HQ "held" (Crimson Knights 2 at 1,8).

Mostly the army. Five bodies against three won every objective count but one, and the Riders' AI made its Round 2 Fall Backs inside the centre's area, so the Horns' charges won no ground. The Horns' AI lost the right objective that ended the battle in Round 4 and spent its CP and Al-Kimiya Ingredients for little, but the Riders led 21-8 before that.

closing: Saladin's pair and the Isfahsalar's pair hit hard where they reached, and LEAD FROM THE FRONT paid them for going forward. But the Cappadocian Riders had a unit on every objective and slipped every charge without leaving the centre, and the Horns of Hattin never had the numbers to take ground back.
